eps.o: It's been 100 years since the world felt sunlight. Toshiro, fleeing poverty and a violent mother, decides to transflorate his body for 10 million yen.
On his first day at Transflora Medical, Toshiro takes on a case: a pianist searching for her father's spiriflor. Her intentions aren't what they seem.
With anti-transfloration tensions rising and a killer on the loose, Yomiko turns to Toshiro for help. But he's consumed by how little time he has left.
Toshiro joins the hunt for Ivy, driven by revenge. Meanwhile, a struggling father is drawn into the anti-transfloration movement for his daughter's sake.
Akira and Kanaeno are down. Toshiro braces for death — but Ivy doesn't kill him. Instead, it speaks. "That person took my sister." The voice is a child's.
Following Ivy's mention of "the Parade," Toshiro ventures into Paupertown — and discovers a ritual of sacrifice designed to keep the system alive.
Clearing Transflora Medical's name means proving Ivy wasn't part of it. But as Toshiro and Yomiko dig, it becomes harder to believe in the system.
As Hikasa launches his anti-transfloration party, Yomiko devises a bold ambush to capture one of his men. But will it lead them to the proof they need?
The protests at the Transfloration Board are nearing a breaking point. Yomiko's gamble: forge a document and draw out the mastermind behind Ivy.
Everything falls apart. Akira is captured, the document seized — and an unexpected face suddenly appears. Meanwhile, Yomiko makes her move.
Shielding Yomiko in the half-destroyed train, Toshiro makes contact with Ivy and is pulled into the painful memories of the child trapped inside.
As a life-and-death fight rages, Mukuru asks Toshiro for friendship. Meanwhile, Yomiko makes a deal with Kudai and learns the truth behind transfloration.
